How It Works

From tired to inspired in four simple steps

No demolition. No dumpster. No weeks of construction. Most jobs are start-to-finish in a single day.

1

Free Estimate

Call or fill out the form. We assess your surface and give you an honest, fixed quote — no hidden fees.

2

Prep & Repair

We deep-clean, fix chips and cracks, mask the area and ventilate — the prep that makes a finish last.

3

Spray & Glaze

A professional fine-finish coating is sprayed on in your color of choice for a smooth, glossy result.

4

Cure & Enjoy

Surface cures fast — most tubs are ready to use within 24 hours, backed by our written warranty.

Why The Bath Pros

It’s not paint. It’s a professional finish that lasts.

Anyone can roll on a DIY kit that peels in a year. We use commercial-grade bonding agents and spray coatings — the same approach the national leaders use — applied by hand with obsessive prep. That’s the difference between a finish that lasts 18 months and one that lasts 15 years.
